聊天返回确认并广播服务器时间；空白内容按原样广播。

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "user.update",
  "requestId": "user",
  "data": {
    "name": "alice",
    "email": " A@B.C ",
    "clientTimeMs": 100
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "chat.send",
  "requestId": "chat",
  "data": {
    "content": "hi"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "chat.send",
  "requestId": "chat",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "chat.message",
  "data": {
    "content": "hi",
    "sentAtMs": 1,
    "user": {
      "name": "alice",
      "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
    }
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "chat.send",
  "requestId": "blank-chat",
  "data": {
    "content": "   "
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "chat.send",
  "requestId": "blank-chat",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "chat.message",
  "data": {
    "content": "   ",
    "sentAtMs": 1,
    "user": {
      "name": "alice",
      "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
    }
  }
}
